testcase.name: Scenario: Commit a separator as the only custom panel item: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:867:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Commit a separator as the only custom panel item ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software with the Tools ribbon visible ✔ And the Part Tools custom panel list is empty ✔ When the user opens ribbon customization with All Commands selected ✔ And the user double-clicks "<Separator>" in the available list ✔ Then the custom panel list contains one separator ✔ When the user clicks OK ✔ Then no User Commands panel is visible on the Tools ribbon ✔ When the user reopens ribbon customization ✔ Then the Part Tools custom panel list contains one separator ✔ When the user double-clicks the separator in the custom panel list ✔ And the user clicks OK ✔ Then no User Commands panel is visible on the Tools ribbon
